kebab_example: aliyun ecs create-hpc-cluster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name hpc-Cluster-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateHpcCluster

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the HPC cluster. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: HPC集群所在的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The description of the HPC cluster. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh:
HPC集群描述。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。

默认值：空
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The name of the HPC cluster. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: HPC集群名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、英文句号（.）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: name
